export.title: Astronaut health summary
export.disclaimer: Screening and environmental classification only; it does not replace the flight surgeon's assessment or personal dosimetry.
rec.cortisol.0: Record a sample to get a recommendation.
rec.cortisol.2: Repeat the sample at the same time within 24-48 h.
rec.cortisol.3: Confirm with a second sample and notify the flight surgeon.
rec.radiation.0: Repeat the reading: it could not be classified.
rec.radiation.2: Repeat within 1-5 min and check position and space weather.
rec.radiation.3: Notify ground control, confirm with a second dosimeter and follow the shelter protocol.
rec.mental.green: Keep the sleep and recovery plan.
rec.mental.yellow: Schedule 45 min of rest after the task.
rec.mental.orange: Block high temporal-demand tasks the next day.
rec.mental.red: Notify the flight surgeon and restrict EVA/robotics.
warning.bv_tv_out_of_range: Predicted BV/TV ({value}) is outside the physical range on {date}.
warning.reference_out_of_range: Age {age} is outside the 20-74 reference range; the nearest band ({band}) was used.
level.1.name: Normal
level.2.name: Risk
level.2.tip: Bone loss is faster than the calcaneus average: increase exercise load.
level.3.name: Alert
level.3.tip: Bone loss has reached hip and spine levels: clinical review required.
exercise.title: Recommended exercise protocol
exercise.1.title: Level 1 · Maintenance
exercise.1.item.1: HEM/ARED: heel raises with a short squat and hip abduction.
exercise.1.item.2: DECD: periodic jump sessions to load the sole of the foot.
exercise.1.item.3: Complementary aerobic work on treadmill and cycle ergometer.
exercise.2.title: Level 2 · Load adjustment
exercise.2.item.1: Increase lower-body resistance load (calcaneus and femur).
exercise.2.item.2: Add more jump cycles on the DECD platform.
exercise.2.item.3: Add brief high-intensity isometric series (10 s).
exercise.3.title: Level 3 · Maximum intervention
exercise.3.item.1: Maximum directed load for hip, trochanter and calcaneus.
exercise.3.item.3: Maximize DECD under flight surgeon supervision.
exercise.disclaimer: Guidance only; the final prescription belongs to the flight surgeon.
